title: Larkspur Closing Cost Credit: Reservation Channels, Verification Documents and Annual Limits
content:
For each Larkspur Closing Cost Credit program the loan origination desk works from the same short list of reservation terms: the loan file statuses in which the credit may be reserved, the channels through which it may be reserved, the documents that verify eligibility, the calendar days after reservation by which verification must be complete, how many credits of the program one customer may reserve in a calendar year, and whether a later program or amount change re-tests eligibility.

| Credit program | File statuses in which it may be reserved | Reservation channels | Verification documents | Verification deadline (calendar days after reservation) | Reservations per customer per calendar year | Program or amount change re-tests eligibility |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit | disclosed, processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | loan officer; online portal | occupation verification | 30 | 1 | yes |
| Larkspur Returning Customer Credit | disclosed, processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | loan officer; online portal | prior closing record | 30 | 1 | yes |
| Larkspur First Home Credit | disclosed, processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | loan officer; online portal | homebuyer education certificate; income verification | 30 | 1 | yes |
| Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee | disclosed, processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | loan officer | signed guarantee terms | 10 | 1 | yes |
| Larkspur Builder Partner Credit | disclosed, processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | loan officer | builder partner agreement | 60 | 1 | yes |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant | disclosed, processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | loan officer | census tract lookup; income verification | 30 | 1 | yes |
| Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant Plus | disclosed, processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended | loan officer | census tract lookup; income verification; homebuyer education certificate | 30 | 1 | yes |

### Points of reading

- The verification deadline is a number of calendar days counted after the reservation.
- Only the Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit, the Larkspur Returning Customer Credit and the Larkspur First Home Credit may be reserved through the online portal; every program may be reserved through a loan officer.
- The shortest verification deadline belongs to the Larkspur On-Time Closing Guarantee (10 calendar days) and the longest to the Larkspur Builder Partner Credit (60 calendar days).
- Every program allows one reservation per customer per calendar year, and every program is re-tested on a program or amount change.
